scenes.caption: The sign said he was close. / All he could see was more road.
His legs began to shake. / He fell. Got up. Fell again.
Defeated, he sat down. / Ready to give up.
Just beyond the hill... / He had no idea how close he was.
He looked at his trembling hands. / Then slowly pushed himself up.
This time, he didn't run. / One step. Then another...
YOU CAN'T ALWAYS SEE HOW CLOSE YOU ARE. / KEEP GOING.
